title: euphrasia nemorosa var. minima
intro: Euphrasia nemorosa var. minima, commonly known as dwarf eyebright, is a small, annual or biennial plant belonging to the family Orobanchaceae. It is traditionally used to treat eye problems, respiratory issues, and digestive disorders due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Euphrasia nemorosa var. minima include reducing inflammation, soothing eye irritations, and relieving coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
